#WPT /workers/: what still fails, and why

tools\wpt.ps1 runs the whole /workers/ folder (its sub-folders included). Expectations: wpt\expectations\workers.txt (written by tools\wpt.ps1 -Update -Suites <a file listing workers>). State on 2026-10-26 (tranche 5): 295 tests, 271 OK, 1021 of 1323 subtests pass (77.2 %).

The 23 tests that still end in TIMEOUT (some only under the load of 8 tests at once), by cause:

GroupTestsCauseCan it be fixed here?
Other hosts and HTTPSSharedWorker_dataUrl, data-url-shared, modules/*-import-csp, modules/*-import-referrer, modules/shared-worker-options-credentials, the cross-origin cases of modules/shared-worker-import* and shared-worker-parse-error-failureThey load from https://{{domains[www1]}}:{{ports[https][0]}} or HTTPS_REMOTE_ORIGIN. The local WPT server answers on 127.0.0.1 over HTTP only: these hosts do not resolve, and no HTTPS port answers.No: it is the test server, not the browser. A full wptserve (DNS names, a certificate) would run them.
Windows a test opensSharedWorker-extendedLifetime* (4)They open windows (window.open), close them, and check that a shared worker outlives its last client. The runner drives one page with no window shown, and does not open popups.Not in this runner. The extendedLifetime option itself is implemented (tranche 1).
A MessageChannel in a shared workersemantics/multiple-workers/008A shared worker creates a MessageChannel and passes a port to a dedicated worker it starts: the port's messages do not arrive. (Nested workers themselves work since tranche 5: nested_worker* pass.)Yes: under investigation.
Frames that navigatesemantics/navigation/001, 002, semantics/reporting-errors/004, opaque-originAn iframe navigates and goes back (history.back() inside a frame), or runs sandboxed with an opaque origin. Frame session history and sandboxed origins are incomplete.Partly. The work belongs to the frames and history code, not to workers.
Storage partitioningshared-worker-partitioned.tentativeA shared worker seen from a third-party frame must be another one. Shared workers are keyed by the partitioned storage key since tranche 5 (storage.partitioned), but the test's third-party frame is on another host (get-host-info REMOTE_ORIGIN), which the local WPT server does not serve.It belongs to the "other hosts" group; tools\partition_e2e.ps1 checks the partitioning.
TimingWorker-postMessage-happens-in-parallel.https, sometimes Worker-creation-happens-in-parallel.https and SharedWorkerGlobalScope/name/*They measure that a worker runs while the page is blocked, or just take long under load (8 tests at once). Their expectations accept both results (OK|TIMEOUT).They pass on their own.
Remaining bugsWorkerGlobalScope-close ("errors are delivered after close"), semantics/encodings/004.worker, SharedWorker_blobUrl (its cross-origin frame)Under investigation.Yes.

Fixed during tranche 5:

  • Nested workers (new Worker() in dedicated and shared workers): nested_worker*, the nested case of dedicated-worker-in-data-url-context.
  • modules/shared-worker-import.window and modules/shared-worker-options-credentials pass on their own (only their cross-origin cases fail); under load they still time out at times (OK|TIMEOUT).

Fixed during tranche 4:

  • Synchronous XMLHttpRequest in workers. It fixes the worker-performance subtest and semantics/xhr/*.
  • A worker's uncaught error that its Worker object did not cancel now reaches window.onerror.
  • requestAnimationFrame works in dedicated workers.
  • A worker's script and importScripts() require a JavaScript MIME type over HTTP(S).
  • A module shared worker whose graph fails fires error at its SharedWorker. Before, the test hung.
  • /html/webappapis/structured-clone/ is fetched, which brings the structured-clone battery.
  • These test server handlers are now ported to Go: common/redirect.py, the baseurl redirects, helper-redirect.py, and the modules/resources/*.py scripts.
  • .headers files now replace the server's Content-Type.
